name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
description: A complete blood count (CBC) is a blood test used to evaluate overall health and detect a wide range of disorders, including anemia, infection, and leukemia.
requirements: Fasting not required. Inform technician if taking any medications.
procedure: A small blood sample is drawn from a vein in your arm using a sterile needle.
reference_ranges: WBC: 4,500–11,000 cells/mcL; RBC: 4.5–5.9 million cells/mcL (male), 4.1–5.1 million cells/mcL (female)

name: Vitamin D (25-Hydroxy)
description: This test measures the level of 25-hydroxyvitamin D in the blood to assess vitamin D deficiency or toxicity.
requirements: No special preparation needed. Inform your doctor about any supplements you're taking.
procedure: A blood sample is collected from a vein in your arm using a sterile needle.
